scenes.heading: EXT. HOMESTEAD COURTYARD - EARLY MORNING
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Amar receives the eviction notice and conceals it from his mother to protect family peace
scenes.emotional_change: Amar moves from quiet work routine to suffocating panic, hiding the financial debt in his waistcoat

scenes.heading: INT. FAMILY HEARTH & KITCHEN - AFTERNOON
scenes.mood: Simmering fraternal conflict colliding with matriarchal sanctity
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Kabir demands liquidation of ancestral acreage for city visa; Bebe defends the soil; Amar stays silent
scenes.emotional_change: Kabir erupts in accusations of stagnation; Amar absorbs insults rather than break his mother's heart

scenes.heading: EXT. THE DRY CANAL & ANCESTRAL GROVE - SUNSET
scenes.mood: Tragic revelation dissolving into tearful fraternity and shared redemption
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Amar reveals the ₹34 Lakh medical debt notice; Kabir renounces his departure to stand with his brother
scenes.emotional_change: From bitter fratricidal hostility to tearful remorse and united determination to plow ancestral soil

canonical_characters.name: Amarjit Singh
canonical_characters.personality: Stoic, dutiful, carries debt in secret

props_inventory.cultural_equivalent: Urdu stamp paper land intiqal / Kurki notice
